title: Evaluation of Three Different Antalgic Blocks in Total Knee Prosthesis
official: Evaluation of Different Antalgic Blocks in Total Knee Prodthesis
summary:
This randomised trial examines the three main anaesthetic blocks used in knee replacement surgery, comparing them in terms of analgesic efficacy (primary outcome), range of motion and degree of flexion in the immediate post-operative period.

Other outcomes include medication use and an analysis of any differences based on sex and age.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Total Knee prosthesis
* ASAC I-II
* signed Informed consent form

Exclusion Criteria:

* \<40 years
* Mental confusion and delirium
* Coagulation disorders
